sections.title: How we use cookies
sections.description: We use cookies to improve functionality, security, and analytics. You can read more about each category below.

sections.title: Essential
sections.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled in our systems.

sections.title: Security
sections.description: Security cookies help us protect your information and prevent fraud.

sections.title: Functionality
sections.description: Functionality cookies allow the website to remember your choices and improve your user experience.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.description: Analytics cookies help us understand how the website is used and improve our services.

sections.title: Advertising
sections.description: Advertising cookies are used to show relevant ads and measure the effectiveness of our campaigns.

sections.title: More information
sections.description: If you have any questions about privacy or cookies, get in touch or visit our Cookie Policy for details about all cookies, their duration, purpose, and instructions on withdrawing your consent.
